Rule_Name: Workload Compute Objective Must Be Explicit

Inputs: Workload type; workload execution objective; required performance metric
Input_Source: Workload specification; existing workload classification rules
Threshold_or_Value: Threshold not universally established; workload-specific characterization required.

Rule_Name: Arithmetic Intensity Is Workload- and Kernel-Dependent
